summary: Web UI: the Archived page now shows all of the signed-in user's archived memos regardless of which Space is selected (it used to be filtered by the current Space), and the Archived entry moves out of the Home/Explore switcher in the sidebar into the user menu.

statements.why: Front-end only; the archived list is still limited to the signed-in user's own memos (Archived.tsx creatorName: user?.name); no access, data or money change.

misses.what: Archived memos are now shown from all Spaces together, no longer filtered by the selected Space.
Archived is no longer in the sidebar's Home/Explore switcher; users now reach it from the user (account) menu.
